title: How to Create Projects in Business Central (2025)

chapters.title: Introduction to Projects in Business Central
Creating a New Project and Assigning Details
Adding Planning Lines and Budget Information

features.name: Project list in role center
features.description: The project manager role center displays a list of projects, allowing quick access to all active projects.

features.name: Project card creation
features.description: Business Central automatically assigns a project number when creating a new project. Users enter basic information like description and select a customer.

features.name: Project manager assignment
features.description: Users can assign themselves or another person as the project manager, which controls visibility in their role center.

features.name: Project task numbering
features.description: Project task numbers are typically part of a number sequence defined in setup. Users can customize the numbering scheme.

features.name: Project task types
features.description: Project tasks have configurable types such as posting type, which allows adding budget information on planning lines.

features.name: Project planning lines
features.description: Planning lines allow users to enter budget and billable information, with line types supporting budget, billable, or both configurations.

features.name: Resource and item allocation
features.description: Users can add resources (people doing the work) and items to project planning lines, with automatic cost and price calculations from resource or item master data.

features.name: Project details pane
features.description: The project details pane displays totals for costs and invoicing information, helping project managers stay on budget.

features.name: Project posting groups
features.description: Project posting groups can be selected per project or configured globally in the project setup window to control posting behavior.

features.name: Copy project tasks feature
features.description: Users can create new projects and copy tasks from existing projects using the create new project assisted setup guide, saving time when setting up similar projects.
caveats: Users can leave tasks blank to copy all tasks

features.name: Copy dimensions and quantities on apply tab
features.description: When copying project tasks, users can optionally copy quantities and dimensions through the apply fast tab.

objects.name: create new project assisted setup guide

quotes.text: From the project manager RO center, we'll use the navigation list to see our list of projects.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the starting point for project management within Business Central using the role center interface.

quotes.text: Business Central assigns the project number and we'll enter basic information like a description.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that project numbers are auto-generated and users only need to provide basic descriptive information.

quotes.text: Typically the project task number is part of a number sequence that we define.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains that task numbering is configurable through number sequences defined in setup.

quotes.text: The line type can be budget or billable or both depending on the line cost and how we bill a customer.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the flexibility of planning line types for different billing and budgeting scenarios.

quotes.text: The cost and price amounts come from the resource or item assigned.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that costs and prices are automatically derived from master data, not manually entered.

quotes.text: We should choose a project posting group. We can choose these per project or in the project setup window.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the flexibility of applying posting groups either at project level or globally in setup.

quotes.text: When we set up other similar projects, we can save time by copying tasks.
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces the task copying feature as a productivity feature for managing multiple similar projects.
